sloka: तवास्त्रबलमासाद्य नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः ।न शेकुः समरे स्थातुं सुरेश्वरसमाश्रिताः ।। ५.४८.३।।।।
transliteration: tavāstrabalamāsādya nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ ।na śekuḥ samare sthātuṁ sureśvarasamāśritāḥ ।। 5.48.3।।।।

translations.english: "None could face you in war including Indra, Maruts and gods because of your skill and the power of your astras.
